title: Follow-up Calls and Callbacks
summary: This topic is mainly about service writers scheduling, attempting, or requesting follow-up calls and callbacks, with only a small number of fragments expressing dissatisfaction tied to unresolved issue communication.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on customers requesting callbacks for unresolved vehicle issues or being asked to report back after diagnosis rather than receiving a clear resolution.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly document call logistics such as scheduled follow-ups, ended calls, attempted callbacks, or instructions to call back, without clear sentiment.

limitations: Most fragments are undetermined process notes about calls, so the sample provides limited evidence about customer satisfaction with follow-up communication.
Some examples are terse or ambiguous, and at least one fragment appears to involve phone-call behavior in the vehicle interface rather than service follow-up, so the cluster is not fully uniform.
